source_identity.canonical_title: L'intersectionnalité empêche des personnes marginalisées de creuser leur propre tombe par haine envers d'autres personnes marginalisées

translation.canonical_title: Intersectionality prevents marginalized people from digging their own graves out of hatred for other marginalized people
translation.displayed_title: Intersectionality prevents marginalized people from digging their own graves out of hatred for other marginalized people
translation.summary: By recognizing that all forms of discrimination are interconnected, marginalized groups avoid yielding to the lure of hatred toward other marginalized groups. For example, a racialized person may be homophobic and vote for a politician who is also homophobic while overlooking the fact that they themselves are among that politician’s targets, thereby digging their own grave with their ballot.
